draft.subject: Getting your first North Works project started
draft.body:
Hi Keiko,

Thanks for flagging the notification badge and the VAT invoice earlier — both tickets are closed on our side, and a VAT number can be added to invoices from billing settings going forward.

On the workspace itself, the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so one real project is usually the quickest way to see whether Wrenfield fits how North Works works.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you.

Best,
Priya
